title: MajidFQ/documind-rag
summary: documind-rag是一个基于RAG的聊天系统，支持PDF/DOCX文档交互，采用双分块策略、跨编码器重排序和自动忠实度/幻觉检查层。使用FastAPI、ChromaDB、sentence-transformers和Groq LLM构建，适用于需要高效文档检索和生成的场景。，基于模型推理的架构
description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for chatting with PDF/DOCX documents — featuring dual chunking strategies, cross-encoder reranking, and an automated faithfulness/hallucination-check layer. Built with FastAPI, ChromaDB, sentence-transformers, and Groq LLM.
